subject: latvian
summary: Latvian cards are clean and the diacritics render correctly everywhere. The attached reading text is the right passage for each card and opens on the passage itself, with no other questions visible on the first page. The main faults are presentational: multi-part vocabulary questions (a)-(e) are run together as one sentence, every scheme point carries a repeated grey boilerplate note ('The scheme prints this as the meaning of ... The examination prints this question in Latvian and it is answered in LATVIAN.') that is longer than the actual answer, and the essay card has no marking content at all, only a 0-40 number grid. On the phone there is a large empty band between the attachment button and the answer box.

issues.title: Lettered sub-parts flattened into one run-on line
issues.detail: The vocabulary questions list five phrases (a)-(e) with paragraph references, but they are printed as one continuous sentence: 'Izskaidrojiet saviem vārdiem frāzes (a) zem velēnām (1.rindkopa) (b) no tumsas uz gaismu (2.rindkopa) (c) ...'. On the phone this wraps over five or six lines with the labels landing mid-line.
issues.suggested_fix: Put the instruction on its own line and each of (a)-(e) on a separate line, as a short list.

issues.title: Repeated boilerplate note on every scheme point
issues.detail: Each of the five scheme boxes starts with the same grey two-sentence note ('The scheme prints this as the meaning of "...". The examination prints this question in Latvian and it is answered in LATVIAN.'). The note is three to four lines on a phone and the real answer is often one or two words, so the scheme reads as mostly filler. Cards 2 and 3 carry a similar long note about answering in Latvian and about the scheme giving no mark split.
issues.suggested_fix: Label each box simply '(a) zem velēnām' and show the answer; state the answer-in-Latvian rule once at the top of the scheme, not in every box.

issues.title: Essay card has no marking content
issues.detail: The 40-mark essay shows 'The scheme prints no answer for this part' followed by a paragraph of explanation and a grid of buttons 0 to 40. There are no criteria to mark against, so the student is asked to pick a number out of 40 with nothing to go on. The heading above it still says 'Select the points you actually got', which does not match. The question also says 'write on one of the topics' but shows only one topic.
issues.suggested_fix: Either show general essay criteria (content, structure, language) if the scheme has them elsewhere, or drop the 0-40 grid and offer only the Missed it / Shaky / Got it choice with a plain one-line note. Show both essay titles if the paper offers a choice.

issues.title: Empty band between question and answer box on phone
issues.detail: After the attachment button there are roughly 200-230 pixels of blank white space before the 'Your answer' label on every card, which looks like a missing element.
issues.suggested_fix: Collapse the question area to its content height on the phone.

issues.title: Stray punctuation and inline numbering in scheme answers
issues.detail: Several answers end with a trailing comma left over from the scheme's list ('miris,', 'izdzīvo stiprākais,'), and one answer runs three alternatives together as '1) ticēt tam, ko saka 2) uzticēties 3) ieklausīties un ticēt sacītajam'.
issues.suggested_fix: Strip trailing commas; put numbered alternatives on separate lines.

issues.title: Attachment button labelled 'Read Question N'
issues.detail: The button for the reading passage is headed 'READ QUESTION 1' / 'READ QUESTION 5', and the reader header says 'QUESTION 5 · SOURCE TEXT'. What opens is the shared reading passage, not a question, so the label is misleading. The orange underline under the whole question appears on cards 2 and 3 but not on 1, 4 or 5.
issues.suggested_fix: Label it 'Read the passage' and apply the underline consistently or not at all.
